name: filter-bar
title: Filter Bar
description: Content-driven project filter bar that wraps within its available container.
docs: Search and status fields wrap by available space, including desktop side panels. Use URL parameters or application state as the source of truth; fetching and routing stay in the application. Use variant=outlined (default) for a standalone block and variant=plain when embedded in a page. Controls retain their own boundaries. Apply uses a soft action so the page primary action remains prominent.
